references.text: The oil that makes the face shine, and the bread that strengthens the human heart - olive and its oil are mentioned as one of God's gifts to humanity
Pure, pressed olive oil was to be used for the lamp in the tabernacle, showing the holy significance of the olive tree in the worship of God
The olive tree is mentioned as one of the blessings in the promised land, a sign of God's goodness and abundance
Israel is compared to a fruitful olive tree, beautiful with good fruit - the olive tree as a symbol of God's people
Israel's glory shall be like that of the olive tree - the olive tree used as an image of beauty and blessing
Paul uses the image of the olive tree to explain the relationship between Israel and the Gentiles who are grafted in
David compares himself to a green olive tree in God's house - the olive tree as an image of the righteous who thrive in God's presence
